title: nashsu/llm_wiki
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that addresses a specific need in information management, making it monetizable.

zh.gap: 真正需要它的是文件夹里全是 PDF 的律师、研究生、研究者，而他们连第一页都没看到就走了：模型配不上、局域网连不通。

voices.quote: 接 openai、kimi、minimax 的模型，全部都 analysis failed。实在是没招了，每个 api 都不行

zh.pain: 硬盘里躺着十年的文档，想问它一句话都问不了。现有工具第一步是配 API key——律师和研究生就卡死在这里。
zh.kill: Obsidian、Notion 今年都在发同一个功能，而文档本来就在它们手里；「把文件夹变成 wiki」是演示惊艳、活不过第二周的东西。
zh.move: 卖前五分钟，不卖引擎：签名安装包、自带能用的模型，一条「指一个文件夹，十分钟拿到 wiki」的固定路径，先从卷宗审阅切入——那批文档制度上就不许上云。

gap: It hits a real pain but the first five minutes are geek-only. The person who needs this is a lawyer, a graduate student, a researcher with a hard drive full of PDFs — and the tracker is full of them failing at model configuration, folder selection and LAN Ollama endpoints before they ever see a wiki page.
pain: A person with ten years of documents on their own laptop and no way to ask them a question — 15.8k stars in four months, and 219 open issues where those same people are stuck on an API key.
kill: Obsidian, Notion and every note app are shipping the same feature this year, and they already hold the documents. 219 open issues against 33 contributors is a maintenance line going the wrong way, and 'turn my folder into a wiki' is a demo that dazzles once and then has to survive the second week.
move: Sell the first five minutes, not the engine. A signed installer with a working model bundled or one paid key on the vendor's account, an opinionated 'point at this folder, get a wiki in ten minutes' path, and a single named profession as the launch wedge (start with case-file review, where the documents are private by obligation and cloud AI is disallowed). Cold start (Chinese): the llm_wiki issue tracker and the self-organised WeChat group its users opened in issue #158 — they are already assembling without the maintainer; Cold start (English): r/ObsidianMD and r/LocalLLaMA, search 'ask my own documents offline'.
